notes: Reduce Cloudflare D1 writes: reading reaction lists no longer restores and rewrites per-actor reaction keys.
Batch reaction reads share one state lookup and preserve both users' likes.
Incremental encrypted backups update only changed products, reactions, journal and task scores when a recent full snapshot is available.
Periodic full backup refresh remains enabled after 60 seconds; no data migration or reset.
versionPolicy: Крупное обновление: следующий целый номер. Мелкое обновление: следующий десятичный номер. Один пакет изменений = один production deploy.
